Rashi on Nedarim 37b:10:1.english: And [words that are] written but not read: “na” of “yislach” - [That] of Naaman.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:1:1.english: If they were lost - on Shabbat.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:1:2.english: He does not bear responsibility for them - Since he is not hired on the day of Shabbat.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:1:3.hebrew: אם היה שכיר שבת - שנותנים לו ז' פשיטים שכרו לשבוע. אע"פ שמגיע ליום שבת פשוט אחד, כיון דכל יום שבת נבלע עם שכירות שאר השבוע — זו היא הבלעה, ששכר שבת מבליע בתוך ימי השבוע — נותנין שכר שבת, דהבלעה שרי:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:1:3.english: If he was hired for a week - [Meaning] that they give him seven peshitim [as] his wage for the week. Even though one pashut is allotted to the day of Shabbat, since the entire day of Shabbat is absorbed with the hire of the rest of the week — this is havla'ah [absorption], that the wage of Shabbat is absorbed within the days of the week — they give [him] the wage of Shabbat, for havla'ah is permitted.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:1:4.hebrew: אם אבדו - בשבת, חייב באחריותן, דהא נותנין לו שכר השבת:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:1:4.english: If they were lost - On Shabbat, he bears responsibility for them, since they give him payment for Shabbat.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:2:1.hebrew: אלא גבי שבת - דקתני לא קורין בתחילה אבל שונין, לאו משום שכר פיסוק ולא משום שכר שימור קאמר, דהא שרי בהבלעה:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:2:1.english: Rather, with regard to Shabbat - [That] which it taught, "they may not read for the first time, but they may review," it does not say [that this is] because of wages for punctuation [of verses] nor because of wages for watching [the children], for that is permitted through inclusion [with weekday wages].

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:2:2.hebrew: דיפנו אבהתהון דינוקא למצוותא דילהון - שאם היו עסוקין להקרותן בתחילה בדבר חדש, היו טרודין בהן ולא היו פנויין למצות שבת להתענג בו. אבל שונין, הואיל וכבר למדוהו, לא מיטרדי בהו:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:2:2.english: So that the fathers of the children will be free for their mitzvah - For if they were occupied in teaching them to read for the first time — [i.e.,] a new matter — they would be preoccupied with them and would not be free for the mitzvah of Shabbat, to delight in it. However, [when] reviewing, since they have already learned it, they are not preoccupied with them.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:2:3.english: That they will be at leisure - So that they will be free.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:2:4.hebrew: ויקיר להו עלמא - שכבד עליהם ללמוד מפני המאכל, ולהכי אין קורין בתחילה בשבת, דמצער להו:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:2:4.english: And the world is heavy upon them - For it is heavy upon them to study because of the food, and therefore they do not read [a passage] for the first time on Shabbat, because it distresses them.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:3:1.hebrew: בנות - שמלמדין אותן תורה, מי בעיין שימור? אינהו לאו אורחייהו למיפק אבראי, דכתיב "כל כבודה בת מלך פנימה" (תהילים מ״ה:י״ד), וליכא לאוקמא בה שכר שימור:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:3:1.english: Daughters - whom they teach Torah — do they need watching? It is not their way to go outside, as it is written: "All glorious is the king's daughter within" (Psalms 45:14), and one cannot establish regarding it payment for watching.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:4:1.english: Payment for punctuation of cantillation notes is by Torah law - And he cannot take payment for them.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:5:1.hebrew: אלו הפסוקים - עד היכן מסיים כל פסוק ופסוק, ולהכי קרי להו שום שכל, שיכול להשכיל בפסוק בין כל פיסוק ופיסוק:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:5:1.english: These are the verses - [Meaning] up to where each and every verse ends; and for this reason it calls them "giving sense," because one is able to comprehend the verse [by distinguishing] between each and every break.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:6:1.english: Halakha [transmitted] to Moses from Sinai - That they are read thus.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:7:1.hebrew: מקרא סופרים ארץ ארץ - כלומר, מה שקורין ארץ, ארץ, דלא כתבינן ההברה — דלא כתבינן יו"ד בין אל"ף לרי"ש ובין רי"ש לצד"י; וכן נמי ארץ, דלא כתבינן ב' אלפי"ן או ה"א סמוך לאל"ף ויו"ד בין רי"ש לצד"י; וכן שמים, דלא כתבינן שאמים — אל"ף בין שי"ן למ"ם ובין מ"ם ליו"ד; וכן מצרים:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:7:1.english: The reading of the scribes [mikra soferim]: eretz, aretz - That is to say, how we read eretz [and] aretz, as we do not write the pronunciation [with vowel letters] — for [in eretz] we do not write a yod between the alef and the reish, nor between the reish and the tzadi; and so too [in] aretz, we do not write two alefs, or a heh next to the alef, and a yod between the reish and the tzadi; and similarly [in] shamayim, we do not write sha'amayim [with] an alef between the shin and the mem and between the mem and the yod; and similarly [in] mitzrayim.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:8:1.hebrew: עיטור סופרים אחר תעבורו - ולא כתיב תעבורו אחד, והיינו עיטור, שמעטרין הדיבור, דהכי משמע יפה:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:8:1.english: The ornamentation of the scribes: “Then [aḥar] you shall pass on” - And it is not written “you shall pass on afterward,” and this is [what is meant by] “ornamentation” — that they adorn the expression, for thus it sounds better.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:8:2.english: The singers go before, the minstrels [follow] after - And it is not written, “After the minstrels, the singers go before.”

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:8:3.hebrew: צדקתך כהררי אל - ולא כתיב כהררי אל צדקתך, דהכי מסתבר טפי ובדווקא משתעי:
Rashi on Nedarim 37b:8:3.english: Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains - And it is not written "like the mighty mountains is Your righteousness," for this makes more sense and speaks with precision.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:9:1.english: [The word] "man" [in] "as if a man inquired of the word of God" - [This] is written regarding Ahithophel.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:9:2.english: "Come" of "and [the city] shall be built" - [It is] read, but not written.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:9:3.english: “Her” of “escape” - Both of them are written in Jeremiah.

Rashi on Nedarim 37b:9:4.english: “Et” of “it has been told,” [and] “to me” - All of these are read but not written.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:10:1.english: Na of yislach - In [the story of] Naaman.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:1:1.hebrew: שכר שבוע נותנין לו שכר שבת ואם אבדו חייב באחריותן - כדין שומר שכר, דמחייב בגניבה ואבידה. ואין להקשות "חפצי שמים הוא" — דקבלת שכר לאו חפצי שמים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:1:1.english: "[If he was] hired for a week, they give him Shabbat wages, and if they were lost, he is liable for them" - [This is] according to the law of a paid bailee, who is liable for theft and loss. And one should not object, "It is [a matter of] Heavenly affairs," for receiving payment is not [a matter of] Heavenly affairs.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:2:1.hebrew: אלא היינו טעמא דאין קורין בראשון דיפנו אביהם של תינוקות - ולאו משום שכר שבת כלל, אלא אפי' כשאביהם של תינוקות מלמדין אותן בחנם, שיהיה להם פנאי, שיהא פנוים לסעודת שבת; ואם יקראו בראשון, ישהו שהייה מרובה. וה"ה אם יש להם מלמד בשכר, שאסור מהאי טעמא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:2:1.english: "Rather, this is the reason that we do not read initially, so that the fathers of the children may be free" - And [this is] not because of Shabbat wages at all; rather, even when the children's fathers teach them for free, [it is prohibited so] that they will have leisure, that they be free for the Shabbat meal; and if they read initially, they would tarry a long time. And the same applies if they have a paid teacher, that it is prohibited for this reason.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:2:2.hebrew: אבל שונין בראשון - דתו ליכא שהייה כל כך, כיון שמלמדים כבר:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:2:2.english: But they review what was [learned] the first [time] - For there is no longer so much delay, since they are already taught [it].

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:2:3.english: For its mitzvot - of the Shabbats.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:2:4.hebrew: ואיבעית אימא - טעמא דאין קורין: משום דבשבת אוכלים טפי מבחול, ויקיר עלייהו עלמא — כלומר, שכבדין הם מפני שינוי ווסת, דאין יכולין לעסוק ולטרוח וללמוד בראשון:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:2:4.english: And if you wish, say - The reason they do not read [for the first time]: because on Shabbat they eat more than on a weekday, and the world is heavy upon them — that is to say, they are sluggish due to the change in routine, such that they cannot engage, exert themselves, and learn [it] for the first time.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:3:1.hebrew: בנות מי בעיין שימור - ומתני' סתמא קתני, בין בנים ובין בנות; ובנות ליכא יוצאניות ולא בעיא שימור, א"כ לא שייך בהן שכר שימור:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:3:1.english: "Do girls need watching?" - And the Mishnah states [this] without distinction, [applying to] both sons and daughters; and [among] daughters, there are none who go out [into the streets], and they do not need watching. If so, payment for watching does not apply to them.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:4:1.english: Payment [for teaching] the punctuation of cantillation notes is by Torah law - And it is forbidden to take payment for them.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:5:1.english: These are the verses - [This refers to] the place where the verse ends.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:5:2.hebrew: ואמרי לה אלו המסורות - מאן דאית ליה פיסוק טעמים לאו דאורייתא, מפרש "אלו המסורות" — חסירות ויתירות:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:5:2.english: And some say: These are the traditions - The one who holds that the punctuation of cantillation notes is not of biblical origin explains [that the verse refers to] "these are the traditions" — [meaning the] deficient and plene [spellings].

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:7:1.hebrew: מקרא סופרים ארץ ארץ - [שמשתנין] באתנחתא וזקף קטן, וכן שמים, מצרים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:7:1.english: "The vocalization of the scribes: eretz, aretz" - They change with an etnachta and a zakef katan; [and similarly] shamayim [and] mitzrayim.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:8:1.hebrew: עיטור סופרים - דלכאורה משמע דאחר תעבורו, וסבריה ואחר תעבורו; וכן אחר תאסף — ואחר מסתבר, אחר נוגנים — ואחר משמע:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:8:1.english: The ornamentation of the scribes - For at first glance, aḥar ta'avoru [without a vav] implies [a different sense], and its intended meaning is ve-aḥar ta'avoru ["and afterward you shall pass on"]; and similarly, aḥar te'asef — ve-aḥar ["and afterward"] makes sense; [and] aḥar nog'nim — ve-aḥar ["and afterward"] is implied.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:9:1.hebrew: פרת דבלכתו - "להשיב ידו בנהר פרת" — "פרת" אינו כתוב, ונקרא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:9:1.english: "Euphrates" of "as he went" - [The verse continues:] "to establish his control over the river Euphrates" [II Samuel 8:3] — "Euphrates" is not written, yet it is read.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:9:2.hebrew: איש דכאשר ישאל - פי': "כאשר ישאל איש בדבר האלהים" — "איש" קרי ולא כתיב:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:9:2.english: "[The word] 'man' (ish) that [is in] 'as [a man] inquires'" - Explanation: [In the verse] "as a man (ish) inquires of the word of God" [II Samuel 16:23], [the word] "man" (ish) is read but not written.

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:9:3.hebrew: באים דונבנתה - "הנה ימים באים ונבנתה" — "באים" קרי ולא כתיב:
Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:9:3.english: "Ba'im" [come] of "venivnetah" [and it shall be built] - [In the verse:] "Behold, the days come [ba'im] [...] and [it] shall be built [venivnetah]" [Jeremiah 31:37], [the word] "ba'im" is read [keri] but not written [ketiv].

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:9:4.english: Et of “It has been told” - [Referring to the verse:] “It has been told to me et that you have done” [Ruth 2:11].

Tosafot on Nedarim 37b:9:5.english: "To me" [elai] of "the threshing floor" - "To me" [elai], if not.
